title: Scene_Map POPUPS! (I want to display text, on the map or damage values) [ RPG MZ ]

posts.author: sensen
posts.body:
In
RPG MAKER MZ
, can values (numbers) and text be displayed in colors, without them being inside a message?
For example, an NPC whose name is Zack and his name is red, or can damage be displayed in colors (for example, when a player steps on a floor that does damage (DamageFloor), or when he takes damage from a trap (Damage popup), for example?

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
You're going to have to be way more specific.
There is no damage pop up for traps. Traps are something you event.
If you are using a plugin, make sure to specify what you are using. I recommend reading our brand new and fancy support templates our wonder mod Meg just made to ensure we can help you quicker and understand each other far better:

posts.author: sensen
posts.body:
These plugins were made mainly to show custom damage values in turn-based battles (Scene_Battle), The CharacterPopupCustomize, allows you to customize the colors of the skills according to the element, the loss of hp, mp, etc.
Well, I'm polishing my ActionRPG
(I'm doing very well with the combat)
, The CharacterPopupDamage, allows me to show the damage values when the player is attacked on the map (Scene_Map) or when the player attacks an enemy (event), WHAT I WOULD LIKE TO FIX OR SOME ADVICE to manually modify the CharacterPopupCustomize or the CharacterPopupDamage, so that when an attack is made with a skill and it has its respective color, the damage popup appears according to the color of said element configured in the (Scene_Map).
In turn-based battles there is no problem, the colors are displayed according to the skill element, but when the damage popping is done on the map (Scene_Map), it always comes out white.
One of the main plugins for actionRpg to work is the MapBattleMain.js plugin (As it is paid and has a license I cannot put it in, but I can put what it calls the damage popping function on the map)
I get the impression that it's not a difficult thing to do... but I'm making it complicated for myself.
